events.verdict: Dunn (CHI) intentionally kicks the ball.
Joseph (IND) sets the pick on Dunn (CHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes marginal contact with Sabonis (IND) during rebounding that does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Young (IND) moves laterally into Markkanen's (CHI) body and creates contact at the end of the drive that affects his SQBR.
Carter Jr. (CHI) slightly extends his hands against Bogdanovic's (IND) side as he sets the pick and makes contact, but it is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced video] Sabonis (IND) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes contact with Sabonis' (IND) left shoulder/arm after his gather.
Young (IND) maintains legal guarding position as contact is made with Dunn (CHI) after the defensive switch takes place.
[Observable in enhanced video] RAR shows Oladipo (IND) gathers the ball with both hands at the top of the perimeter after dribbling and takes an additional dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] LLB shows Oladipo (IND) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Oladipo (IND) makes clean contact with the ball as he defends LaVine (CHI) on the perimeter.
Carter Jr. (CHI) sets the pick on Joseph (IND) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Dunn (CHI) commits the take foul on Oladipo (IND) in the backcourt.
Dunn (CHI) makes marginal contact with Joseph (IND) during the inbound.
LaVine (CHI) moves his pivot foot.
Dunn (CHI) places his hand on Oladipo's (IND) opposite side hip and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Harrison (IND) commits the take foul on Bogdanovic (IND) in the backcourt.
Markkanen (CHI) sets the screen on Oladipo (IND) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Oladipo (IND) makes "high-five" contact with LaVine (CHI) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (CHI) places, but does not extend, his hands against Collison's (IND) backside as he sets the pick.
Harrison (CHI) is already in Oladipo's (IND) defensive path as slight contact takes place, but it is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced video] Oladipo (IND) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Turner (IND) sets the pick on Dunn (CHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Markkanen (CHI) makes marginal body contact with Oladipo (IND) after his gather.
Turner (IND) makes marginal contact with Dunn (CHI) on the dunk.
Harrison (CHI) makes marginal contact with Oladipo (IND) after he receives the pass.
Dunn (CHI) and Oladipo (IND) make incidental contact with one another prior to the held ball.
Turner (IND) sets the pick on Dunn (CHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
LaVine (CHI) briefly grasps Young's (IND) shorts, but does not affect his FOM.
Carter Jr. (CHI) sets the pick on Oladipo (IND) after the hand-off and gives him room to avoid the contact.
LaVine (CHI) slides his pivot foot.
[Observable in enhanced video] Young (IND) fails to fully clear the lane within three seconds.
[Observable in enhanced video] Markkanen (CHI) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
RAR shows Collison (IND) briefly has his arm around Markkanen's (CHI) midsection before correcting.
Oladipo (IND) never has possession in the frontcourt and his momentum carries him into the backcourt, where the pass was directed, and he legally gains possession.
Turner (IND) sets the screen on Dunn (CHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Carter Jr. (CHI) slightly extends his right elbow from the frame of his body, but keeps it collapsed as initial contact is made with Oladipo (IND) during the screen.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a made basket by LaVine (CHI) is overturned. LaVine did not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) steps out of bounds when he receives the pass prior to his shot attempt.
